items.title: 🎨 Five new looks, any colour theme
items.body: Settings → Theme → UI Setup picks the shapes and type while your colour theme keeps picking the colours. Grimoire is a tabletop ledger, Ops Console a monospace readout, Lumen frosted glass, Arcade a visual-novel HUD, Inked graphic-novel panels. Each restyles everything DES draws at once: the scene tracker, chat bubbles, the Present Characters shelf, the Doom Counter, every window and the message box, with its own D glyph. Classic is the look DES always had, and it is still what you have until you pick another.

items.title: 🖼️ A background painted for each look
items.body: With Setup background on (it is, by default), each setup paints a SillyTavern background in your theme's colours, saves it to your Backgrounds panel and selects it. Change the theme and it repaints. Pick your own background and DES leaves it alone. Go back to Classic and the background you had before comes back.

items.title: 💬 A calmer message box
items.body: Under every setup but Classic, SillyTavern's message box becomes one quiet row: Options and the wand, the message, Continue and Send. Buttons and whole toolbars that other extensions add wait behind a single ⋯ button, so the row never clutters however many extensions you run. Nothing is replaced, only rearranged, so everything keeps working. Settings → Theme → Enhanced composer turns it off.

items.title: 🧭 A Settings window with a rail
items.body: Sections sit as icons down the left and you see one page at a time; long pages split into sub-menus under their heading instead of one long scroll. Advanced and History Persistence now live at the bottom of Generation, Inline Banners and Chat Bubbles under Theme, Bunny Mo under Lore Library. If you are updating, your Settings window keeps the stacked list it had; Settings → Theme → Settings window switches to the rail.

items.title: 🫧 Bubble Fill, per character
items.body: Workshop → Appearance → Dialogue color → Bubble Fill paints that character's speech bubbles. On Auto the fill is their dialogue colour and the words its opposite (blue gives yellow); or pick any fill and text colour you like. Handy when two characters share a colour. Off for everyone until you turn it on.

items.title: ✨ Glint Words
items.body: List words that matter in your story and they light up in chat. When a new message arrives, each one plays a flash of light, a sparkle burst, a shockwave ring or a pop, then keeps its look for good: gold, silver, crimson, arcane, frost, prism and more, or your own colour. Start from a preset group like Treasure or Magic in Settings → Theme → Glint Words.

items.title: 🔊 Every character can have a voice
items.body: A Voice tab in the Character Workshop gives each character one of Google's Gemini voices (through your Google key or an OpenRouter key), or a voice you design from a description, or one you clone from a recording of yourself. Settings → Voices turns DES voices on, can read new messages automatically, and lets you design a narrator voice. A bullhorn on every message reads it aloud in the right voices. Designed and cloned voices can be renamed from Settings → Voices → My custom voices.

items.title: 🔧 Fixes and small additions
items.body: Workshop → Appearance has a Recrop portrait button that reframes the portrait you already have. The Doom Counter badge is readable under every look (under Inked it is a paper sticker now). This screen now appears with Performance Mode on instead of leaving a dark backdrop. Bubble Fill saves on its own and survives per-chat saves. The Lore Library's campaign icon picker is no longer cut off. Settings rows no longer crush their labels on phones. Dialogue with | or {{ no longer breaks the bullhorn buttons. The strip-colour-tags setup no longer overwrites your own SillyTavern TTS regex.
